blocks.caption: Neuron ki teen qismein
rows: CNS ke bahar, guchhon mein jinhein ganglia kehte hain
unipolar: aik lamba dendrite jis ka sira receptors tak shakhon mein batta hai, aur aik axon
multipolar: bohat se shakhdar dendrites, lamba axon
chhote axons jo qareebi circuits banate, ya lambe axons jo door ke hisson ko jorte hain

blocks.text: Inter-neurons sensory neurons ya doosre inter-neurons se impulses le kar motor neurons ya doosre inter-neurons ko dete hain. Chhote axons wale qareebi neurons ke saath circuits bana kar chhoti maloomat ka tajziya karte hain; lambe axons wale dimagh aur spinal cord ke mukhtalif hisson ko jorte hain.

blocks.alt: Teen panel. Sensory neuron: oopar receptor se neeche CNS tak aik lamba myelin wala hissa, cell body aik taraf ganglion mein. Inter-neuron: chhote dendrites aur chhote axon wala cell body, poora dimagh ya spinal cord ke andar. Motor neuron: CNS mein bohat se dendrites wala cell body aur lamba myelin wala axon jo muscle par khatam hota hai.
blocks.caption: Neurons ki qismein (Figure 15.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Sensory neurons impulses receptors se CNS tak le jate hain; un ke cell bodies CNS ke bahar ganglia mein hote hain. Inter-neurons poore taur par dimagh aur spinal cord ke andar hote aur sensory neurons ko motor neurons ya doosre inter-neurons se jorte hain. Motor neurons impulses CNS se effectors tak le jate hain; un ke cell bodies CNS mein hote aur un ke bohat se dendrites hote hain (multipolar).

blocks.title: Matan ke baare mein
blocks.text: Kitab sensory neurons ko 'sirf aik lambe dendrite' wala unipolar kehti hai. Zyada tar ko pseudo-unipolar kehna behtar hai: cell body se aik hi shakh nikal kar do mein batt jati hai, aik receptor se aati lambi shakh aur aik CNS mein jati shakh.

blocks.prompt: Sensory aur motor neurons ke cell bodies kahan hote hain?
blocks.explanation: Sensory neurons: CNS ke bahar ganglia mein (jaise dorsal root ganglia). Motor neurons: CNS ke andar.

items: Sensory: receptor se CNS, cell body ganglia mein, unipolar. Motor: CNS se effector, multipolar. Inter-neurons: poore CNS mein.
